title: Warak Enab
description: Cozy Middle Eastern dish featuring a yeasty, cheesy center, served in a hot pot. The binchotan-charcoal adds a smoky flavor to the dish.
instructions: In a small bowl, combine yeast and warm water. Let it sit for 5 minutes, until frothy.
In a large mixing bowl, combine flour, salt, and whole grain mustard. Mix well.
Add the yeast mixture to the dry ingredients and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes, until smooth.
Transfer the dough to a lightly floured surface and shape into a sphere.
Place the dough in a hot pot and cover with a lid.
Preheat the binchotan charcoal until hot, and place it on top of the dough.
Reduce heat to medium-low and cook for 30 minutes, or until the dough has doubled in size.
Remove the charcoal and place the labneh cheese in the center of the dough.
Cover the hot pot and cook for an additional 10 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and the dough is golden brown.
Serve the Warak Enab hot, garnished with chopped parsley and garlic.
